dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: Please take note that the announcement concerning the marriage between Sir Kujou Kamaji and Lady Hiiragi Chisato has been found to have been released in error due to a miscommunication within the Kanjou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: We sincerely apologize for any subsequent confusion or misunderstandings.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: The staff involved have been severely reprimanded, and the Shogunate pledges to enhance communication discipline and eliminate any such incidents in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: Let it be known that the matrimonial ceremonies have been delayed, and that further details will become available at a later date.

dialogues.speaker: Hanamizaka Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This Hanamizaka bulletin board was set up by the Shogunate. Notices regarding all sorts of matters will be posted here. Do not post without authorization.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: Former Tenryou Commissioner Kujou Takayuki has presently been relieved from his post. He faces charges of dereliction, corruption, endangering the nation and its people, among others, and is awaiting judgment.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: Due to his age and in consideration of his accomplishments, he has been confined to his quarters indefinitely, and will not be released on bail.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: If he commits any other offenses, he will be punished with extreme prejudice and without clemency.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: While the Tenryou Commission discusses matters of reformation, its duties shall be performed by a personal deputy of Her Excellency.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: There will be no adjustment in Doushin and Yoriki ranks. Overall command has been ceded to Madam Kujou Sara.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "The Man" Itto
dialogues.text: "Kujou Tengu! I think the entrance to Hanamizaka is a good spot for a sumo duel! Where are you!?"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "The Man" Itto
dialogues.text: "Put all that military and governance stuff aside for a day, and let's have a good match! Or did you leave your samurai honor on the battlefield where you dropped it?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Huh. Come to think of it, I haven't seen a single public sumo match held on any street ever since the Sakoku Decree took effect."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Madam Kujou Sara, please assent to Mr. Arataki's challenge for once! This might be out of line, but we too would like to witness your might!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Dear citizens, please do not join hands with those who harass public officials and vandalize public property!

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Madam Kujou Sara has given us repeated assurances that she has nothing to do with this person!

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: I'm searching for my husband, Inaba Tousaburou Kyuuzou. He is a tall man without any facial hair and has a scar on the side of his forehead. He has yet to return home despite the ceasefire.

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: If any returning samurai or old friends and acquaintances know of his whereabouts, please inform me. You will be duly thanked for your help!

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: Yours Respectfully, Inaba Shizuko.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: We urge all citizens to remain calm. The Tenryou Commission's stability and its management of Tenshukaku's defense are now in Madam Kujou Sara's capable hands.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: Rest assured that Kujou Takayuki's militant brutality, forced seizure of Visions, and suppression of the citizenry is now being reversed post-haste!

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Smithy Notice
dialogues.text: "Due to recent peace treaty between the Shogunate and Sangonomiya, the supply of Jade Steel has ceased."

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Smithy Notice
dialogues.text: "There will still be many days ahead, and government policy may yet be adjusted..."

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Smithy Notice
dialogues.text: "Please wait a while longer if you have any need for Jade Steel weapon restoration or forging."

dialogues.speaker: Amenoma Smithy Notice
dialogues.text: "I, Amenoma Tougo, sincerely apologize, and wish for your understanding."

dialogues.speaker: Bantan Sango Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Bantan Sango: We'll investigate anything on your behalf!"

dialogues.speaker: Bantan Sango Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Missing persons, missing pets, marital investigations, criminal investigations, commercial commissions, delivery services, procurement services..."

dialogues.speaker: Bantan Sango Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Just make us a suitable offer, and we'll even capture the likes of bandit chiefs Zenigata or Domeki for you!"

dialogues.speaker: Bantan Sango Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Oh, and by the way, do not believe that Heizou person who calls himself a 'detective'! He's a liar and a charlatan!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Is this what they call intra-service rivalry?"

dialogues.speaker: Bantan Sango Reply
dialogues.text: "We're not competitors — we're not even in the same line of work!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Konda Village has a large dye field that is presently in need of re-cultivation, and we are short of manpower to accomplish this task. As such, I'd like to ask for some help from some youngsters from the city."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Our village is far from rich, but as long as you're willing to work, I, Konda Densuke, promise that you will be well compensated!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Those of you with families can bring them here to Konda Village. Food and board will be provided by us, all the better to make the village thrive more!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Chief, wouldn't it be better just to do some paid tourism or something rather than make advertisements like this one?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Oh, shut it with your crazy ideas! We're not taking anyone's Mora!"

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: Returning, demobilized samurai can report to the Yashiro Commission estates to receive subsidies and indicate their preferred avenues of future employment.

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: Additionally, the Grand Narukami Shrine will hold sharing sessions for samurai who took part in the war and their families to help heal the traumas caused by the war.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Seirai Island is being plagued by pirates once more, and the Yashiro Commissioner's reconstruction proposals have been delayed time and time again by the war..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Thankfully, a ceasefire has been signed. Perhaps now the Asase Shrine there can finally be refurbished."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "It's just that it's been several hundred years now. Who knows how many of the descendants of Seirai Island's inhabitants still have some impression of their homeland..."

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: Their Excellencies, the Almighty Ogosho and Watatsumi's Divine Priestess, both express their deep grief at the many tragedies that occurred at Tatarasuna and on Yashiori Island.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: From this day forth, the Shogunate and Sangonomiya will begin reconstruction and redevelopment work in these lands in partnership with one another.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: Together, we will pacify this war-torn land, bring the guilty to justice, and restore Inazuma's prosperity.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: All the more must we follow the divine wisdom of Her Excellency the Shogun, acting as one to accomplish the great cause of Eternity.

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Restaurant Advertisement
dialogues.text: "The Kiminami Restaurant will only serve the freshest and most authentic Inazuma cuisine!"

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Restaurant Advertisement
dialogues.text: "Anyone ordering take-out will be greeted with Miss. Anna's smile!"

dialogues.speaker: Kiminami Restaurant Advertisement
dialogues.text: "May a sweet smile bring you a beautiful day!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "She's just forcing herself to smile to bring in more business, isn't she..."

dialogues.speaker: Fire Brigade Notification
dialogues.text: "If any citizen discovers Ms. Yoimiya setting off restricted fireworks inside the city, please try to stop her!"

dialogues.speaker: Fire Brigade Notification
dialogues.text: "...Or reprimand her, at least. Do not indulge her!"

dialogues.speaker: Fire Brigade Notification
dialogues.text: "Alternatively, please refrain from accepting the fireworks she gives out. That will do as well!"

dialogues.speaker: Fire Brigade Notification
dialogues.text: "The Fire Brigade hereby urges everyone to pay special attention. Thank you very much!"

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "Though this is not a serious matter, I still hope that it will become more common knowledge."

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "The other day, I accidentally lost the only extant copy of the famous 'Toki Alley Tales,' written by Takizawa Kyouden."

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "Though it's nothing major, Lady Yae still insisted that I post a lost book notice to look for it. Ah, what a headache..."

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "That poor book has probably had its pages scattered to the winds by now... I don't suppose it would be possible to find it at this point."

dialogues.speaker: Hiratsuka, Yae Publishing House
dialogues.text: "It really is nothing of note, but if anyone could help recover it, you will have the Yae Publishing House's thanks."

dialogues.speaker: Yae Publishing House Advertisement
dialogues.text: The signed hardcopy edition of "A Legend of Sword" by Liyue's best-selling author, Zhenyu, is flying right off the shelves!

dialogues.speaker: Yae Publishing House Advertisement
dialogues.text: Purchase your copy now and receive special setting notes and exquisite character badges as part of the package!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry, but I just had to ask: where is the author's signature? I took my copy home and I wound up spending the whole day looking for it, but without success."

dialogues.speaker: Yae Publishing House Advertisement
dialogues.text: *Special Note: the author's signature is quite the tortured thing, and may be mistaken for the pattern on the box set's lid without careful observation.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Popular authors who fail penmanship... Is that the way of the world nowadays?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "My young samurai friends, the doors of Shimura's are always open to you!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Lost your job? Not lucky in love? Whatever your troubles, come over here for a drink or two!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I, Shimura Kanbei, will welcome you any time!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Children and parents of the city and beyond: if you should be bullied by a red oni with long horns such that you lose toys, cards, Onikabuto, snacks, picture books, and things of this kind..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Please come down to Hanamizaka and look for Kuki Shinobu. I will do my best to return the lost items to you. Regrettably, I will not be able to help you with toys that have been broken or food that has already been consumed."

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "To the Victor Go the Spoils" Itto
dialogues.text: "Hey, hey, Shinobu, you aren't taking pity on the vanquished again, are you?"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "To the Victor Go the Spoils" Itto
dialogues.text: "Those are trophies, you know? Trophies! I won them fair and square — and it was a lot of effort, too! You can't just give them all back just like that!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Oh, is that so? In that case, I won't drag you back the next time that tengu woman beats the snot out of you."

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "The Undefeated" Itto
dialogues.text: "Oh, come on, don't be like that!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "You know, it's your fault that I'm more acquainted with every Doushin in the Police Station than I ever needed to be..."

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "No Prison Food For Me" Itto
dialogues.text: "I never asked for you to get me out of there! Also, what's with that psychiatric evaluation you used to bail me out last time? Were you making fun of me!?"

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: Due to citizen reports, the two people who vandalized this noticeboard have been detained.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Notice
dialogues.text: We are familiar with one another, yes, but please control yourselves.
